from collections import Counter
def transform(grid):
    counts = Counter(v for row in grid for v in row)
    bg = counts.most_common(1)[0][0]
    other = [v for v in counts if v != bg]
    if len(other) == 1 and counts[other[0]] == 1:
        marker = other[0]
        return [[0 if v == marker else marker for v in row] for row in grid]
    return [[0 if v == bg else bg for v in row] for row in grid]
